# Commercial Mortgages Southampton
> Specialist commercial mortgage broker for Southampton, the Solent corridor and Hampshire. Port and logistics, retail, hospitality, semi-commercial, HMO portfolio, healthcare and trading-business commercial mortgages from a 90+ lender panel including Shawbrook, InterBay Commercial, LendInvest, Cynergy Bank, Lloyds, NatWest, Barclays and Santander. Indicative terms in 48 hours, completion typically 4 to 8 weeks.

## Key Facts
- Service: Commercial mortgages
- Coverage: Southampton, Eastleigh fringe, Hedge End / West End, the Solent corridor and wider Hampshire
- Facility size: £150K to £10M
- Term: 5 to 25 years
- LTV: typically 65 to 75% (semi-commercial up to 75%, hospitality and trading-business 60 to 70%, industrial 65 to 70%)
- Rates (mid-2026): 6.0 to 9.0% pa
- Lender panel: 90+ lenders
- Decision time: indicative terms in 48 hours
- Named lenders: Shawbrook, InterBay Commercial, LendInvest, Cynergy Bank, Lloyds, NatWest, Barclays, Santander, plus 80+ others
